title: OJAJ etap II gram.-leks.: formy czasownika

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij zdania poprawnymi formami czasownikow podanych w nawiasach. Uzywaj pelnych form, np. does not zamiast doesn't.

items.context: I'm used to _________ on the left because I've lived in England for some time. (drive)
She tried to be serious but she couldn't help _________. (laugh)
I wish I _________ something to read. It's so boring sitting in this waiting-room with nothing to do. (have)
My parents never let me _________ after 10. (stay out)
It's high time you _________ a job. I'm fed up with supporting you! (find)
I had great difficulty _________ a good nanny for my two-year-old. (find)
If I _________ about the meeting, I'd definitely have attended it. (inform)
It's time we stopped _________ about our next move. We need to have a clear plan. (think)
Byron is said to _________ on vinegar and potatoes. (live)
